title: Major Changes for This City in Texas
description:
Temple’s Bold Revitalization: What It Means for You

Temple, TX is undergoing major changes, and if you live here—or are thinking about moving—this is a must-watch! 🚧🏡 The city’s “Love Where You Live” initiative is bringing new businesses, housing developments, and infrastructure improvements, but how will this impact real estate and home values?

📍 What You’ll Learn in This Video:
✅ Downtown Temple’s transformation – new luxury apartments, restored historic sites, and business growth
✅ Neighborhood improvements – where home values are rising and where affordability is shifting
✅ New infrastructure projects – road expansions, accessibility upgrades, and park developments
✅ Economic growth – what new businesses and job opportunities mean for residents
✅ Pros & cons of Temple’s revitalization – how this could affect property taxes and affordability

Were the Home in Texas Team - Ali Thompson + McKenna Tagart. We are a mother/daughter Real Estate Team focused on helping families buy and sell their homes in Belton, Temple, Salado, Harker Heights and Killeen Texas. 

In this episode we take you through the new Imagine Belton Plan set to revitalize Downtown Belton, and different neighborhoods to live in, in Belton Texas.
